fields.title: Conditioning and regeneration
fields.finding: Initial90%conditioning and1day release time constant are inherited proxies. Ground350C regeneration energy assumes cp1kJ/kg/K and2xloss factor.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure drydown, repeat-cycle residual moisture, vacuum pumping work, cooldown and handling. Regenerate outside the PBO enclosure.

claim: Initial90%conditioning and1day release time constant are inherited proxies. Ground350C regeneration energy assumes cp1kJ/kg/K and2xloss factor. | Conditioning and regeneration
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
